remarks: Welcome to Wilton Crest-where convenience, comfort, and easy living come together in one of Wilton's most accessible locations.  This spacious end-unit one-bedroom offers an abundance of natural light thanks to its desirable corner positioning, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere throughout. The open living and dining area flows seamlessly to a private balcony-perfect for morning coffee, fresh air, or unwinding at the end of the day.  The layout is both functional and comfortable, with generous living space, a well-appointed kitchen, and a large bedroom with ample storage. If you are looking for a low-maintenance lifestyle, this unit checks all the boxes.  Wilton Crest is ideally located just minutes from everything-Wilton Center's shops, restaurants, library, and parks, along with easy access to nearby amenities in Westport and Norwalk. For commuters, you're perfectly positioned with quick access to the Merritt Parkway, I-95, and Metro-North train service.  Residents also enjoy community amenities including a pool, tennis courts, brand new common laundry, and private storage-making everyday living both easy and enjoyable.  A rare opportunity to own a bright, end-unit condo in a location that truly connects you to it all.
